title: Linear Regression and Parameter Tuning Visualization
full_prompt: Create a Manim scene demonstrating Linear Regression with interactive parameter tuning. The scene should feature a custom 'Dial' class (inheriting from VGroup) that represents model parameters (e.g., weight $w$ and bias $b$). The Dial should have a circular arc, tick marks, and a needle that rotates to point to the current value, changing color based on whether the value is positive (blue) or negative (red). Set up a coordinate system (Axes) with a scatter plot of data points. Display a regression line $y = wx + b$ whose slope and intercept are dynamically linked to the values of the dials. Animate the dials changing their values using a custom animation that shows passing flashes along the dial arc, and show the regression line and residual lines (connecting data points to the line) updating in real-time to reflect the new parameters.

visual_techniques: Custom Dial Mobject with rotating needle
Scatter plot with dynamic fitting line
Residual lines (error bars) updating in real-time

common_failure_modes.pattern: Using pfp instead of point_from_proportion in ManimCE environments
common_failure_modes.note: pfp is a ManimGL-specific shorthand. In ManimCE, point_from_proportion must be used.
ManimCE uses ShowPassingFlash or custom flash animations instead of VShowPassingFlash.

common_failure_modes.pattern: Incorrect needle rotation math in Dial class
common_failure_modes.note: The needle's start and end points must be calculated correctly using the arc's proportion-from-point logic to avoid visual misalignment.
